thread:
sam (sales): Hi all — NeonApps wants a 72h POC. Ask: ephemeral Dedicated pool, 5 reserved GPUs, burst to 12 for two demo windows per day (90m each), rotated hosted API key limited to the demo, and either IP allowlist or VPC peering. Need feasibility and a rough cost.

leah (solutions): Quick details please: model + expected sequence lengths and concurrent users. Also will they need public demo link?

sam (sales): Model = redwood-13b-quant; seq usually 512 but up to 1500 for a few long-context demos. Peak concurrent users ~50. Public link required.

ryan (eng-infra): We can spin ephemeral pool with those params. Suggest reserved=5, burst_max=12, burst_window=90m twice/day, autoscale cooldown 4m. Need exact UTC demo windows and CIDR if peering.

jin (eng-runtime): For redwood-13b-quant at 1500 tokens, UX latency will depend on batching. Recommend enabling batching + KV prefix cache. Also add a fallback route to lighter model if queue > 75s. Pin model version to avoid surprises.

mira (security): If they want peering we need completed security questionnaire and their network contact. Otherwise we can issue ephemeral API keys with 72h TTL and IP allowlist. Keys will be scoped to a single project and route.

paul (finance): Rough cost: reserved 5 GPUs x 3 days ~= 360 GPU-hrs reserved. Potential burst (if fully used) up to ~180 GPU-hrs. Back-of-envelope incremental cost ~$4k-$8k depending on utilization. I can allocate a $2k demo buffer.

leah (solutions): I'll prepare a runbook and CLI snippet. Proposed command below — we will include prewarm flag so demo latency stays low.

infra-bot: queued ticket INFRA-POC-5120 assigned to ryan (eng-infra)

leah (solutions): CLI: 

```
rictl pool create \
  --name neonapps-poc \
  --reserved 5 \
  --burst-max 12 \
  --burst-windows "90m,90m" \
  --prewarm 3 \
  --schedule "2026-05-10T13:00Z/2026-05-12T23:59Z" \
  --rbac "team:neon-poc" \
  --notes "72h POC: rotated key; ip-allowlist or peering; monitoring + kill-switch"
```

ryan (eng-infra): Will provision once we have: final window schedule, CIDR list (if peering) or IP list, security questionnaire status, and finance buffer approval. ETA to provision: 36hrs after inputs.

mira (security): I'll post the questionnaire here. If they want peering, we need answers + signed peering agreement at least 48hrs before the scheduled demo start.

paul (finance): Approving $2k buffer. If we hit >$5k please alert immediately.

sam (sales): Thanks — I'll get CIDRs and questionnaire answers from NeonApps and confirm windows. Please also expose a kill-switch to me in the console for the demos.

jin (eng-runtime): Noted — we'll enable token-cost tracing and expose a manual burst-disable toggle to the sales lead. Also pin model v1.0.2.

sam (sales): Great, thanks everyone :thumbsup:
